mapper.select: /* statsInqyDao1010 : 입·퇴사 현황 (메인) */ SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) || '명' FROM EMP_INFO E WHERE E.LEAV_DT IS NULL AND E.HIRE_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND E.HIRE_DT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 12) ) AS NEW_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(*) || '명' FROM EMP_INFO E WHERE E.LEAV_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND E.LEAV_DT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 12) ) AS LEAV_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(*) || '명' FROM EMP_INFO E WHERE E.HIRE_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND E.HIRE_DT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 12) ) AS EMP_CNT , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AS CURR_YEAR FROM DUAL
/* statsInqyDao1030 : 통계 연도 조회 */ SELECT (TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - LEVEL + 1) AS CODE_CD , (TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - LEVEL + 1) || '년' AS CODE_NM FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 5

/* statsInqyDao1040 : 통계 연월 조회 */ SELECT NVL(#{srchYearCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')) || LPAD(LEVEL, 2, '0') AS YEAR_MM , NVL(#{srchYearCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')) || '.' || LPAD(LEVEL, 2, '0') AS YEAR_NM FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12
